Manglo/Playbook/Editorial standards
HOW WE WORK

Useful before impressive. Honest before loud.

How we research, verify, produce and correct Manglo Journal and Playbook content—and how to tell us when we miss something.

Who makes the guides?

Manglo Editorial is an organizational byline for original practical, shopping, technology, AI and selectively verified trend coverage. It does not represent an invented individual or expert. We explain common workflows, show the math behind examples and link to relevant Manglo tools. We do not claim marketplace endorsement or certifications we don't hold.

How we handle examples

Currency examples, margins and product scenarios are labelled illustrative. They are not reported marketplace fees, live price quotes or fabricated customer case studies. When an article includes a calculation, we show the inputs so readers can check it.

Corrections and updates

Requirements, formats and platform policies can change. We review guides when changes come to our attention, update significant content and indicate the modified date. If you spot an error or outdated instruction, contact faikxbillion@gmail.com with the page and correction.

Ads and editorial independence

Manglo does not currently serve Google ads on this site. If advertising is introduced after approval, ads will be distinguishable from editorial content. We will update our privacy disclosures and implement any required consent controls before enabling relevant tracking or ad technology.

What the Playbook isn't

Guides are general educational information—not individualized legal, financial, tax or professional advice. Sellers should verify regulations, rates and platform requirements for their own region and business.

Privacy and reader trust

The current site has no account requirement. We avoid invasive popups and misleading download buttons. Read the privacy policy, terms and contact page for more detail.

Research and sources

Claims that could affect buying decisions or safety require evidence. We prefer current official documentation, primary announcements and original data, and label uncertainty or conflicting sources. We do not invent tests, quotations, prices or personal experience.

AI assistance and accountability

AI tools may assist with topic organization, drafting, formatting or research discovery. Manglo Editorial remains responsible for claims, sources, originality and corrections. Material AI assistance is disclosed where a reader would reasonably expect to know how the work was made.

Images and commercial relationships

Published visuals must be original or used with appropriate permission, and must not suggest a test or real-world event that did not happen. Affiliate relationships and sponsorships, if introduced, will be clearly identified. Payment will not purchase a favorable conclusion.

Our publication gate

Every proposed story must clear accuracy, reader value, source, rights, transparency, accessibility and technical checks. If a gate fails, we skip publication and record an explanation. There is no promise to publish every day or to appear in Google Search or Discover.
